sentences.en: He is hailed as the father of modern anthropology.
sentences.zh: 他被誉为现代人类学之父。

sentences.en: The study of theology is comprised of philosophy, history and anthropology.
sentences.zh: 神学的研究包括哲学、历史和人类学。

sentences.en: I often visited the Museum of Anthropology at my university, UBC.
sentences.zh: 我经常去UBC大学的人类学博物馆参观。

senses.zh: 人类学家 形容词: anthropological

mnemonic: 词根记忆：anthrop（人类）+ology（…学）→人类学
